data.situation:
Back at the outdoor desk, Ruth opened a field notebook. One section recorded the local flora, another the fauna. Maya had photographed a floral display near the doorway; the animal photographs belonged in the faunal record instead. The pages showed diverse living things, but Ruth checked that repeated sightings of the same species were not counted as new kinds. Their variety was part of the site’s biodiversity. Beside the notebook, a diagram connected living things with soil, water and air to show an ecosystem. Jo: Does diversity just mean a large number of animals?
Ruth: No. It refers to different kinds. We also look at the relationships in the ecosystem.
Maya: Can I call the notebook a list of everything that lives here?
Ruth: Only a record of what has been observed so far.

readingBlocks.en: Back at the outdoor desk, Ruth opened a field notebook. One section recorded the local flora, another the fauna. Maya had photographed a floral display near the doorway; the animal photographs belonged in the faunal record instead. The pages showed diverse living things, but Ruth checked that repeated sightings of the same species were not counted as new kinds. Their variety was part of the site’s biodiversity. Beside the notebook, a diagram connected living things with soil, water and air to show an ecosystem.
readingBlocks.zh: 回到室外桌旁，露丝打开野外笔记。一栏记录当地植物群，另一栏记录动物群。玛雅拍了门边花卉展，而动物照片应放进动物记录。页面里有多种生物，但露丝核对同一物种的重复观察没有被当作新种类。它们的多样性属于这里的生物多样性。笔记旁示意图把生物与土、水和空气相连，展示生态系统。

readingBlocks.en:
Jo: Does diversity just mean a large number of animals?
Ruth: No. It refers to different kinds. We also look at the relationships in the ecosystem.
Maya: Can I call the notebook a list of everything that lives here?
Ruth: Only a record of what has been observed so far.
readingBlocks.zh:
乔：多样性只是动物数量大吗？
露丝：不是，指不同种类。我们还看生态系统里的关系。
玛雅：能说笔记列出了这里所有生命吗？
露丝：只能说记录了截至目前观察到的对象。

glossary.example: Another section recorded the local fauna.

externalEvidence.definition: all the animal life in a particular region or period

glossary.note: 本例花卉；原资料另列宽泛植物的义，不泛化所有植物。

externalEvidence.definition: relating to or associated with flowers

glossary.note: 较正式、识读优先的分类形容词。

glossary.zh: 有多种不同类型的；多样的
glossary.note: diverse types/groups；不等于单纯数量大。
glossary.example: The pages showed diverse living things.

glossary.note: 单复数同形；原互相繁殖定义简化，不当作所有物种判据。 外部词典按可互繁殖描述，是常见简化，不适用于所有生物分类。
glossary.example: Repeated sightings of the same species were not new kinds.
glossary.exampleZh: 重复看到同一物种不算新种类。

externalEvidence.definition: (biology) taxonomic group whose members can interbreed

glossary.zh: 不同类型共存的多样性
glossary.note: 本例种类差异，不是总数量。

glossary.zh: 生物种类等方面的多样性；生物多样性
glossary.note: 本例观察不能宣称已完整测得。
glossary.example: Their variety was part of the site’s biodiversity.
glossary.exampleZh: 它们的多样性属于当地生物多样性。

externalEvidence.definition: the diversity of plant and animal life in a particular habitat (or in the world as a whole)

glossary.zh: 生物及其非生物环境相互作用的生态系统
glossary.note: 包含水、空气等非生物因素；原community简化另记。

externalEvidence.definition: a system formed by the interaction of a community of organisms with their physical environment
